name: Xiranite Pylon
description: The Xiranite Pylon can auto-connect to the Protocol Automation-Core (PAC) and Xiranite Relays within 80 meters; and to Xiranite Pylons and other power facilities within 30 meters. When placed inside the Core AIC Area, it can auto-connect to the PAC regardless of distance. This pylon can be used to supply power to facilities within range and transmit power across short distances.
